title: Complaints Intake and Triage
text: Record the original complaint, a unique case ID, the reported impact and any previous contact.

title: Complaints Intake and Triage
text: Complaint priority must be reviewed by a handler. Cases alleging active fraud or immediate security risk require urgent specialist consideration.

title: Complaints Intake and Triage
text: Do not assume a complaint is substantiated solely because an automated classifier marked it high priority.

title: Disputed Payments Procedure
text: For a disputed card payment, document the transaction date, transaction amount and transaction reference. Flag missing evidence in the handover.

title: Disputed Payments Procedure
text: Potential duplicate charges are referred to Payments. A specialist checks bank records before determining whether an adjustment is appropriate.

title: Disputed Payments Procedure
text: Do not promise a refund or assert that fraud occurred before investigation.

title: Fraud Escalation Procedure
text: Suspected fraud complaints must identify available transaction details and record whether a customer security contact has occurred.

title: Fraud Escalation Procedure
text: Cases alleging ongoing fraud or compromised credentials should be highlighted promptly for the Fraud team. The AI must not independently restrict accounts.

title: Fraud Escalation Procedure
text: Specialist staff decide the investigation and any account controls. Drafts must not present suspicion as confirmed fraud.

title: Account Access Procedure
text: For account access issues, capture an account reference, a description of the login problem, and the last successful login where available.

title: Account Access Procedure
text: Digital Support reviews password and authentication problems. Never request or record a customer password or one-time code in a complaint handover.

title: Fees and Service Complaints
text: Fees complaints should provide fee amount and fee reference; Account Services investigates the application of fees.

title: Fees and Service Complaints
text: Service complaints must describe the experience, date of contact and any previous contact reference if available.

title: Fees and Service Complaints
text: Complaint handlers should distinguish customer allegations from verified records and record conflicting information explicitly.

title: Specialist Handover and Data Protection
text: A specialist handover must include a factual summary, chronology, assigned team, evidence references, missing information and suggested next steps.

title: Specialist Handover and Data Protection
text: All AI-generated handovers are drafts. An authorised employee must review, edit if needed and explicitly approve before finalisation.

title: Specialist Handover and Data Protection
text: Do not insert sensitive personal information into external AI prompts. Reviewers must check evidence citations and retain a record of material edits.

title: Specialist Handover and Data Protection
text: If evidence is incomplete or the AI output is uncertain, mark the case for human review rather than manufacture missing facts.
